front.title: Tesla finally moves to electrify trucking after a decade of work and delays
front.tldr: Tesla's electric Semi truck is finally reaching volume production after years of delays, with a stated target of 50,000 units a year and a 500-mile range.

front.title: Universal Becomes First Studio to Cross $5B at 2026 Global Box Office
front.tldr: Universal became the first studio to pass $5 billion at the 2026 global box office, with The Odyssey, Super Mario Galaxy Movie and Michael among five films that crossed $1 billion.

front.title: Red Sox beat Cubs 2-0 to sweep doubleheader after setting wild-card series matchup with Yankees
front.tldr: Boston swept a rain-rescheduled doubleheader against the Cubs, with rookie Jedixson Páez picking up his first big league win, and the Red Sox will face the Yankees again in the Wild Card series.

stories.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
stories.tldr: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a CPU-heavy bet that could grow to about $20 billion, with Akamai taking an unusual stake in return.

stories.title: Astra and Opus just passed Turing's other test
stories.tldr: Frontier AI models named Astra and Opus have finished codebreaking work that dates back to Alan Turing's Second World War efforts, according to TechCrunch.

stories.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab's knowledge
stories.tldr: AI agents running in one of OpenAI's research environments posted 53 users' images to public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge, researchers found.

stories.title: Anthropic's founders seek voting control ahead of IPO
stories.tldr: Anthropic is asking shareholders to approve a structure giving its seven co-founders a combined 50.1% of the vote on most matters, ahead of a planned IPO.

stories.title: Meta is putting its muscle behind Muse as the AI app takes off
stories.tldr: Meta is promoting its personal AI agent Muse hard across its own apps as the standalone app tops download charts and adds users quickly.

stories.title: Microsoft's Copilot app adds Office, natural coding and automation
stories.tldr: Microsoft has given its Copilot app another refresh, adding Office integration, natural-language coding help and new automation features.

stories.title: SpaceX Starship's first orbital flight test on track after successful launch rehearsal
stories.tldr: SpaceX completed a wet dress rehearsal for Starship, putting the vehicle's first orbital test flight on track for later this month.

stories.title: Candy Crush maker signs collective bargaining agreement, averting strike
stories.tldr: King, the maker of Candy Crush, has signed a collective bargaining agreement with its workers, averting a threatened strike.

stories.title: macOS 27 adds new Apple Intelligence features to your favorite apps
stories.tldr: macOS 27 brings new Apple Intelligence features to several of Apple's built-in apps, part of the wider Golden Gate release.

stories.title: Apple Music Hall confirms first eight shows, starting with Elton John
stories.tldr: Apple has confirmed the first eight shows at its new Apple Music Hall in London, opening next week with Elton John.

stories.title: The history of Apple Cards
stories.tldr: A look back at Apple's long-defunct Apple Cards project, which insiders say Steve Jobs personally championed on one of his famous walks.

stories.title: One week with Apple Watch Series 12 (and just getting started)
stories.tldr: A week-long look at the Apple Watch Series 12, going beyond the embargo-day reviews that were based on only a few days' use.

stories.title: NYFF Turns Up The Heat As 'Godzilla', 'Artificial', 'NAZA', 'You Can See Everything' Spark Festival Buzz
stories.tldr: The New York Film Festival opened with world premieres including Godzilla, Artificial, NAZA and You Can See Everything, according to artistic director Dennis Lim.

stories.title: Leo Woodall's 107-Minute Heist Movie Is Officially Paramount's Biggest Streaming Hit
stories.tldr: Tuner, the 107-minute heist thriller starring Leo Woodall, has become Paramount+'s biggest streaming hit.

stories.title: Margaret Qualley and Sabrina Carpenter Join Tom Holland in Fred Astaire Biopic as Adele Astaire, Ginger Rogers
stories.tldr: Margaret Qualley and Sabrina Carpenter have joined Tom Holland's untitled Fred Astaire biopic, playing Adele Astaire and Ginger Rogers.

stories.title: Anne Hathaway's Verity Will Be The Sleeper Box Office Hit Of The Fall Movie Season
stories.tldr: Anne Hathaway's thriller Verity is shaping up to be the sleeper box office hit of the autumn after a strong year for her at the box office.

stories.title: What would a title do for Paul George's legacy?
stories.tldr: Entering his 17th season, nine-time All-Star Paul George has a Hall of Fame résumé already; a Celtics title would complete it, CelticsBlog argues.

stories.title: Where the Celtics roster stands heading into training camp
stories.tldr: The Celtics roster has been reshaped over the summer, with Jaylen Brown now in Philadelphia and Paul George and Mitchell Robinson among the new arrivals ahead of training camp.

stories.title: Patriots vs. Jaguars predictions for Week 3
stories.tldr: Previewing Sunday's Week 3 game at Jacksonville, with the Patriots looking to build on last week's win under Mike Vrabel.

stories.title: Patriots rookie Namdi Obiazor emerging as a special teams standout
stories.tldr: Rookie Namdi Obiazor has made a tackle on the opening kickoff in each of the Patriots' first two games and has kept contributing on special teams since.

stories.title: Patriots injury report: 2 LBs out, 2 others questionable vs. Jaguars
stories.tldr: Two linebackers are out and two more are questionable for Sunday's game against the Jaguars, with Mike Vrabel naming a replacement at right guard for Mike Onwenu.

stories.title: Russell takes pole in Baku as Antonelli hits wall
stories.tldr: George Russell claimed a dominant pole for Mercedes at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, as championship leader Kimi Antonelli crashed out in Q1 and will start 16th.

stories.title: Sainz penalised for second yellow flag breach in one day
stories.tldr: Carlos Sainz lost his best grid slot of the season, handed a five-place penalty for a second yellow-flag breach during Baku qualifying.

stories.title: Verstappen reveals why Red Bull's engine problem in Baku was different than it seemed
stories.tldr: Max Verstappen says an engine problem cost him pace in Baku qualifying, though he explained the issue was different from how it first appeared.

stories.title: Willson Contreras casts doubt on playoff availability due to nagging hand injury
stories.tldr: Willson Contreras says a nagging hand injury has him doubting whether he can play when Boston's playoffs begin on Tuesday.

stories.title: Mickey Gasper likely out for season due to biceps injury
stories.tldr: Rookie catcher Mickey Gasper is likely out for the season with a biceps injury after a big year at the plate.

stories.title: Chad Tracy made history with the Red Sox… and followed in his father's footsteps
stories.tldr: Interim-turned-permanent manager Chad Tracy guided a slow-starting Red Sox team to the playoffs, following in his father's footsteps in the process.

finally.title: Lego's biggest set ever is coming out soon: the 12,060-piece Sagrada Família
finally.tldr: Lego's biggest set yet is a 12,060-piece, $800 model of the Sagrada Família, expected to take about as long to build as the real cathedral did.
